changes: Clicking an unlocked chat's lock opens a profile/position dialog; select an existing profile or create one inline, with existing Settings editing retained.

Profile saving preserves the visible chat until its position is confirmed by the live subscription. Failures preserve the chat; new-profile retries reuse a stable intent ID; a delayed confirmation becomes an explicit retry state.
Mouse drag and 450ms touch hold support moving unlocked chat headers between grid positions and dropping conversation-list rows at chosen positions.
Moving between occupied temporary slots swaps them. A new sidebar chat displaces a temporary occupant only if another open slot can retain it. Locked positions and full grids are protected.
Ordinary clicks retain top-left-to-bottom-right placement; unsent drafts remain bound to their conversation; message-body selection remains available.
Unlocking waits for subscription confirmation before enabling a move, avoiding an old saved position reappearing under a moved temporary overlay.

scope: Dashboard web UI only. No native APK, Functions or security-rule deployment. Browser interaction fixtures used mocked auth/transport; no production chat messages or profile changes were made for testing.
usage: Refresh the open chat window once. Drag a chat by its header; on touchscreens hold first. Unlock a saved chat before moving it, then lock again to save its new position.
